    U[i*m+j, c] for A[i,j], V[j*p+k, c] for B[j,k], W[k*n+i, c] for C[i,k].

    U = [[0]*rank for _ in range(n*m)]
    V = [[0]*rank for _ in range(m*p)]
    W = [[0]*rank for _ in range(p*n)]
    col = 0
    for i in range(n):

                V[j*p+k][col] = 1
                W[k*n+i][col] = 1
